modes.channel_self_test: host/qmp_memory_export.py (128 B loader record; not used for the ring)

stop_rule.default: send stop, poll query-status until paused, read, leave VM paused; never auto-cont
stop_rule.explicit_resume: only --resume sends cont after the report and raw dump are written; --quit requires --resume

read_rule.header_gate: read 128 B first; validate magic/schema/header_len/total_len/cpu_count/entry_size/entries_per_cpu/checksum before any full read or unpack
read_rule.chunk_check: each xp response must decode to exactly the requested byte count
read_rule.active_ring: normal != paused is expected and is not a failure condition

manual_recovery.note: recovery was a separate explicit action after the failure report was saved

address_rule: symbol_vaddr - kimage_voffset from the 03 boot; the 0x70000000 loader page is never used as the ring address
limits: QMP is a local debug interface
frozen snapshot only; no live concurrent decode
full ring cap 1 MiB; current object 164224 B
no claim that 0x70000000 is reserved by the kernel
